real volcano plot 

```{r}

#rewrite volcano plot

# Extract Differential Expression results comparing Day 6 vs Day 0 baseline
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Day", "Day_6", "Day_0"))

# Convert to dataframe and classify significance
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Upregulated Genes (Day6)",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Downregulated Genes (Day6)",
    TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
  ))


# Select top 10 upregulated genes
top10_up <- res_df %>%
  filter(Significance == "Upregulated Genes (Day6)") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)


# Select top 10 downregulated genes
top10_down <- res_df %>%
  filter(Significance == "Downregulated Genes (Day6)") %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)


# Combine genes for labeling
top_genes <- bind_rows(top10_up, top10_down)


# Convert Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
top_genes$gene_symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = gsub("\\..*", "", top_genes$gene_id),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# Replace missing gene symbols with Ensembl IDs
top_genes$gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  is.na(top_genes$gene_symbol),
  top_genes$gene_id,
  top_genes$gene_symbol
)


# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(res_df,
                       aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                           y = -log10(padj),
                           color = Significance)) +
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Upregulated Genes (Day6)" = "firebrick3",
    "Downregulated Genes (Day6)" = "dodgerblue3",
    "Not Significant" = "grey60"
  )) +
  
  # Add significance thresholds
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Label top 10 upregulated/downregulated genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of Differential Gene Expression",
    subtitle = "Genes With The Strongest Transcriptomic Shifts (Day 6 v. Day 0)",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (LFC)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted p-value (FDR)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


# Display plot
print(volcano_plot)


# Save volcano plot
ggsave(
  filename = "HGSOC_Day6_vs_Day0_VolcanoPlot_Top20_DEGs.png",
  plot = volcano_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

```








my labelled volcano plot
```{r}
# Extract DGE results comparing Day 6 v. Day 0
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Day", "Day_6", "Day_0"))

# Create dataframe with significances
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(Significance = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Upregulated Genes (Day 6)",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Downregulated Genes (Day 6)",
    TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
  ))

# Select Top 10 Upregulated Genes 
top10_up <- res_df %>%
  filter(Significance == "Upregulated Genes (Day 6)") %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Select Top 10 Downregulated Genes 
top10_down <- res_df %>%
  filter(Significance == "Downregulated Genes (Day 6)") %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Combine genes for labeling
top_genes <- bind_rows(top10_up, top10_down)

# Convert Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
top_genes$gene_symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = gsub("\\..*", "", top_genes$gene_id),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# Replace missing gene symbols w/ Ensembl IDs
top_genes$gene_symbol <- ifelse(
  is.na(top_genes$gene_symbol),
  top_genes$gene_id,
  top_genes$gene_symbol
)

# Create Volcano Plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(res_df,
                       aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                           y = -log10(padj),
                           color = Significance)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Upregulated Genes (Day6)" = "firebrick3",
    "Downregulated Genes (Day6)" = "dodgerblue3",
    "Not Significant" = "grey60"
  )) + 

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) + 

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) + 

# Label Top 10 Upregulated & Downregulated Genes

  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 3, 
    max.overlaps = 20, 
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3, 
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) + 

  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of Differential Gene Expression",
    subtitle = "Genes With The Strongest Transcriptomic Shifts (Day 6 v. Day 0)",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (LFC)",
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted p-value (FDR)"
  ) + 

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(volcano_plot)

# Save Volcano Plot
ggsave(
  filename = "HGSOC_Day6_v_Day0_VolcanoPlot_Top20_DEGs.png",

  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
